title: Telehealth Visit Checklist
subtitle: Capture patient location, technology check, identity verification, and privacy setting; confirm clinician connection and backup route.
description: Telehealth Visit records patient location, technology check, identity verification, privacy setting, clinician connection, and backup route. Telehealth Visit evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this telehealth visit stage-gated verification when staff must document patient location and technology check. Reconcile identity verification, privacy setting, clinician connection, and backup route before the telehealth visit handoff. Use the appointment record, identity verification, physical-location confirmation, technology test, privacy check, clinician connection log, emergency backup, and after-visit handoff. This encounter centers remote connection readiness, video or audio platform, patient physical location, private setting, callback reliability, clinician link, local emergency route, and reconnection fallback. Ask the assigned telehealth visit reviewer to confirm patient location against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Telehealth Visit starting details review
sections.guidance: Verify patient identity and physical location, callback number, privacy setting, technology readiness, clinician connection, emergency jurisdiction, and backup route. Keep any urgent telehealth visit issue with its escalation contact and time.

sections.title: Telehealth Visit checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current telehealth visit facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Telehealth Visit required checks
items: Patient location is identified for this record
Technology check matches the current request or source
Identity verification is ready for point-of-use staff
Privacy setting limits or questions are resolved
Clinician connection is communicated to the responsible person
Backup route is confirmed at handoff

blocks.label: Telehealth Visit failed or pending items

sections.title: Telehealth Visit decision and readiness
sections.guidance: Hold telehealth visit readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Telehealth Visit reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Telehealth Visit receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
